title: Scott Andrews taken to space command as a child for alien communication
place_text: Air Force base with a space command center

tellings.quote: class and he was taken to, uh, space command to the an Air Force base with a space command center and was doing kind of intuitive communications with aliens.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, talking with a former Army sergeant named Dan Sherman, passes on a story about a man named Scott Andrews. According to Michels, Andrews was taken as a child to an Air Force base with a space command center, a military hub for watching space, where he did intuitive, mind-based communication with aliens. If true, it would mean the military used gifted children to try to talk with non-humans.
